relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a clinically (imaging-based) diagnosed arterial tortuosity syndrome without genetic testing: "Although genetic testing for the SLC2A10 mutations was not performed".
method_note: Read by hand; no script transcription. One in-scope person, the single unnamed patient (label 'patient'), in scope by a diagnosis of ATS (provisional, imaging-based). No SLC2A10 variant tested or reported, so the variants table is empty (no 'not reported' row because no variant is tied to the person). n_patients_reported left null because the schema counts patients with a SLC2A10 variant and none was tested; the paper reports one case. Age wording differs: abstract says 'one-year-old male', case text says current age 'one year and eight months'; the latter used for last evaluation. Age at onset 'At birth' has no number, so ISO is null. 'The rest of the examination was unremarkable' and 'no other syndromic features were evident' are global statements and were not used to exclude any specific feature or checklist item. Morgagni hernia mapped to the checklist item 'diaphragmatic or hiatal (sliding) hernia' (term mapping; paper does not use the word diaphragmatic for it). Morgagni hernia onset left null: it was detected incidentally at eight months, which is detection, not onset. Birth weight 1.95 kg and early-term birth not recorded as features because the paper does not call them abnormal. 'Normal growth parameters' alongside weight faltering/failure to thrive is ambiguous; only failure to thrive recorded. Vital status 'alive' inferred from the current-surveillance sentence. Maternal gestational diabetes not recorded (mother's condition; mother not described as an in-scope relative). No contradictions besides the age wording.
